description: Ruwe gegevens van stiptheid D-1 is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Ruwe gegevens van vertrek en aankomst van (nationale en internationale) reizigerstreinen op al hun stations per dag per treinnummer. Data over de relaties en de spoorlijnen worden ook gegeven. Deze dataset wordt dagelijks bijgewerkt met de gegevens van de vorige dag en deze update overschrijft de reeds bestaande gegevens. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
